subject: Predictions to covariates with a temporal component

messages.author: d44e422f165a3199
messages.subject: Predictions to covariates with a temporal component
parts:
Hi everyone
 

So I’ve set up a model like this now: 

cmp_temp <- Species ~ mySmooth(coordinates,

                               model = matern, group = SurveyID,

                               control.group = list(model = "iid"),

                               ngroup = 10) +

  SST_mean_effect(main=SSTmean,model="linear") + 

  UK_bathymetry_effect(main=UK_bathymetry,model = "linear") +

  UK_bath_slope_effect(main=UK_bath_slope,model="linear") +

  DistShip_effect(main=DistShip,model="linear")+

  DistWF_effect(main=DistWF,model="linear") +

  Intercept(1)

### NOTE - in the above, the temporal component of SST is incorporated into the DATsp dataframe already - this was pre-processed ahead of time.

#######


fit_temp <- bru(components=cmp_temp, data=DATsp, family = "nbinomial",

                options = list(control.inla = list(int.strategy = "eb",

                                                   strategy = "simplified.laplace")))

 

That seems to run.

Now the question is – how do I integrate the temporal SST data so I can make the predictions. At the minute I’ve got this far:


ppxl <- pixels(mesh=mesh, mask = Boundary)

pxlcrds <- data.frame(ppxl@coords)

pxlpts <- sf::st_as_sf(pxlcrds,

                       coords=c("x","y"),

                       crs=UTM30string)

 

ppxl$DistShip_effect <- as.numeric(sf::st_distance(SLs,pxlpts,which = "Euclidean")[1,])

ppxl$DistWF_effect <- as.numeric(sf::st_distance(WFs,pxlpts,which = "Euclidean")[1,])

ppxl$UK_bathymetry_effect <- over(ppxl,Bathycrop)

ppxl$UK_bath_slope_effect <- over(ppxl,Slopecrop)

 

ppxl_all <- cprod(ppxl, data.frame(SurveyID = seq_len(10)))

  

This works fine for the static variables.  But if I’ve got (for example):

 

SST_surv1 <- as(raster(“Data/mean_SST_surv1.img”), “SpatialPixelsDataFrame”)

SST_surv2 <- as(raster(“Data/mean_SST_surv2.img”), “SpatialPixelsDataFrame”)

…

…

 

Is there an inlabru / inla  way to incorporate that temporal component?

 

Cheers

Grant
